verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports MCP servers to plug in third-party tools/capabilities (e.g., Imagen/Veo/Lyria) and ships example integrations like @github, @slack, @database extensions, showing real integration of partner-built agent capabilities into workflows. However, community evidence notes ACP (agent client protocol) support is incomplete ('missing some protocols'), and there's no dedicated marketplace or first-party partner-app ecosystem beyond MCP config. Missing for 10: a curated partner/marketplace ecosystem, complete ACP protocol support, and independent validation of third-party 'agent app' integrations beyond simple MCP tool examples.
